Exact crop from the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side; cover "official text as of April 27, 2013"), PDF page 26: the slip of •Guild Of Assassins. It prints the text of version PC-E3, [[Guild Of Assassins (V) (Errata 3)]] (the current text). The Master List slip prints no slip number (the release-sheet slip and the PC card image print “3-09”). The release sheet heads the slip “•Guild Of Assassins (V)”; the Master List heading prints “•Guild Of Assassins” (a printed-title question already with Bill from Batch T1).<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]] (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
